name: Button Mash
description: Universal in-browser game console: curated browser games, bring-your-own-file EmulatorJS player, GBA-to-browser-game converter, legal-lane emulation guides.
legal: Zero ROMs hosted. Zero piracy links. All game descriptions original (CC0).

endpoints.games: data/v1/games.json — Curated browser games directory (every URL verified live — never invented).
endpoints.emulators: data/v1/emulators.json — Emulator software picks (no ROMs, software only).
endpoints.guides: data/v1/guides.json — Emulation guides and explainers (summaries; full text in data/guides.json).
endpoints.homebrew-packs: data/v1/homebrew-packs.json — Per-system homebrew starter packs: the legal on-ramps for the Player (every URL verified live 2026-10-11).
endpoints.kid-safe: data/v1/kid-safe.json — Kid-safe curated subset of the games directory: games that pass the Kids-mode audit (no open chat, no unmoderated multiplayer chat or user content, no gambling, no graphic/horror content). Each record carries kid_safe, no_chat, age_band (5-7/8-10/11-12), parent_note, verify_live, and audit_basis. Assessments are snapshots, not guarantees.

usage: Static JSON, no auth, no rate limits. Fetch any endpoint directly, e.g. data/v1/games.json. Filter client-side by genre/id/tags. All game descriptions are original (CC0). Game URLs were verified live on 2026-10-11.
